title: Data Structures Practice 3
statement:
Module 4 (Data Structures) covers: arrays and lists, strings, dictionaries and maps, sets, sorting and searching, objects and structures. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 3: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (Dictionaries and Maps).
hints: Re-read the Dictionaries and Maps lesson example.
Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
